properties.label: Recordings page: [CONTEXT_PATH]/blackbox/  ·  Admins can always upload, view and delete.

properties.name: deletePermission
properties.label: Who can delete any recording
properties.description: Empty = admins only. Applies to the recordings they can view.

properties.name: ownerAccess
properties.label: Uploaders can view and delete their own recordings

properties.name: maxSizeMb
properties.label: Max file size (MB)
properties.description: Applies to the video and to session.json separately.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.label: Server logs: the extension tags the recorded tab's requests, and their Joget log lines are kept with the recording.

properties.name: serverLogPermission
properties.label: Who can view server logs
properties.description: Empty = admins only. They must also be able to view the recording.

properties.name: serverLogMaxMb
properties.label: Max server log size per recording (MB)
properties.description: Lines after this are dropped; the viewer says the log was cut off.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of MB.

properties.name: serverLogKeepDays
properties.label: Delete server logs not uploaded after (days)
properties.description: Captured lines wait on the server until the recording is uploaded.
properties.validation_message: Enter a whole number of days.

properties.name: captureTraces
properties.label: Copy Glowroot traces of slow and failed requests
properties.description: Needs server log capture. Glowroot's own slow threshold decides which requests have a trace; it is not changed.

properties.name: glowrootUrl
properties.label: Glowroot address
properties.description: Empty = the Glowroot agent of this Joget (found from its admin.json, usually http://localhost:4000). Read as Glowroot's anonymous user.
